annualized_net_return.title: Annualized Net Return
annualized_net_return.description: Annualized Net Returns (ANR) measure the annual percentage rate of return on the total amount lent after accounting for all gains, losses, fees, and defaults. It represents the effective return on lending amount over a year.

total_received.title: Total Received
total_received.description: The Total Received represents the total amount received by you, including both the principal repaid and the interest earned. This is exclusive of fees.

pos.title: Principal Outstanding

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Loan Tenure
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Tenure is the length of time for which a loan is made. The longer the tenure of the loan, the higher the interest is earned.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Repayment Type
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Repayment type defines the borrower's repayment schedule—EDI for daily installments or EMI for monthly installments.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Risk Category
available_loan_filters_raw.description: LenDenClub score uses a variety of methods to assess the risk of borrowers, including credit scores, employment history, and debt-to-income ratio. The high-risk borrowers comes with a higher rate of interest and low risk borrower comes with a lower rate of interest.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Interest Rate (p.a.)
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Filter loans by annual interest rate. Higher interest rates typically correspond to high-risk borrowers.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Borrower Type
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Defining lending categories based on the type of borrower can be a helpful way to assess a borrower's creditworthiness. This includes the type of borrower based on the income source such as business and salaried which can help make a lending decision.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Monthly Income
available_loan_filters_raw.description: This includes the set of borrowers with different ranges of monthly income. Defining income range helps to determine appropriate loans based on borrowers' financial capabilities.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Loan amount
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Loan amount refers to the total principal sum that a borrower has requested.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Remaining Loan Amount
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Shows loans with the selected range of amount left to be funded.

available_loan_filters_raw.title: Borrower Age
available_loan_filters_raw.description: Filter loans by borrower age group.
